query: HTTP GET https://vizier.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/asu-tsv?-source=J/A+A/632/A59&-out.all&-out.max=unlimited  [VizieR asu-tsv, -source=J/A+A/632/A59 -out.all -out.max=unlimited]; catalogue id verified echoed back in the response by assert_vizier_tsv()
measurement_or_model: MEASUREMENT. lambda_Re, V/sigma, ellipticity from the observed CALIFA stellar velocity maps. M* is a stellar-population MODEL quantity. NO DM halo.
note: RAW UNMODIFIED VizieR response. This catalogue contains 1 table(s): J_A_A_632_A59_tableb1=291. row_count is the SUM of data rows over all tables; per-table counts are in the tables_detail field (VizieR concatenates every table of a catalogue into one asu-tsv response, so a naive line count is inflated by the interleaved headers of later tables).

columns.name: recno
columns.description: Record number assigned by the VizieR team. Should Not be used for identification.

columns.name: ID
columns.description: CALIFA ID

columns.name: eps
columns.description: Average ellipticity measured in the outer parts of the galaxy, using SDSS images

columns.name: PA
columns.description: [] Average position angle measured in the outer parts of the galaxy, using SDSS images

columns.name: Incl
columns.description: Statistical inclination (see Appendix A)

columns.name: Reff
columns.description: Effective radius of the galaxy, measured as described in Walcher et al. (2014A&A...569A...1W)

columns.name: Type
columns.description: Hubble type of the galaxy from Walcher et al. (2014A&A...569A...1W)

columns.name: M*
columns.description: Total stellar mass of the galaxy, measured as described in Walcher et al. (2014A&A...569A...1W)

columns.name: rMAG
columns.description: Total absolute magnitude in r-band from SDSS (Abazajian et al. 2009ApJS..182..543A)

columns.name: C90/50
columns.description: ? Concentration index (ratio of Petrosian radius rad90 and rad50)

columns.name: u-r
columns.description: SDSS Petrosian u-r color index

columns.name: SFR
columns.description: ? Star formation rate based on extinction corrected H{alpha} measurements (Sanchez et al. 2017MNRAS.469.2121S)

columns.name: l0.5Re
columns.description: Apparent stellar angular momentum, {lambda}R measured on an elliptical aperture with semi-major axis 0.5Re

columns.name: lRe
columns.description: Apparent stellar angular momentum, {lambda}R measured on an elliptical aperture with semi-major axis Re

columns.name: l2Re
columns.description: ? Apparent stellar angular momentum, {lambda}R measured on an elliptical aperture with semi-major axis 2Re

columns.name: lRe90
columns.description: Deprojected apparent stellar angular momentum, {lambda}Re,90{deg}

columns.name: (V/sig)e
columns.description: Ordered-over-random stellar motion (V/{sigma})e measured on an elliptical aperture with semi-major axis Re. We refer the reader to Falcon-Barroso et al. (2017A&A...597A..48F, Cat. J/A+A/597/A48) for further properties of the galaxies not listed here.

columns.name: SimbadName
columns.description: Simbad column added by the CDS

columns.name: _RA
columns.description: Positions from Simbad et NED (right ascension part)

columns.name: _DE
columns.description: Positions from Simbad et NED (declination part)
